note: The teacher's curriculum decisions, recorded verbatim. Answers here are hers, not ours. apply-teacher-decisions.mjs checks each record against the state this file assumes before it changes anything, and refuses rather than forcing a change that no longer matches.

grammarMappings.note: All eight pairings confirmed correct as proposed. Only the review flag is cleared; the scans, titles and unit assignments are untouched.

trueFalse.note: The 'Circle ✓ or ×' exercises. The source states no answer for any of them, so these are the teacher's. Question text and pictures are read from the source file at import time and checked against 'text' below; the unit each belongs to comes from the source, not from this list.

answers.text: We use it to cut things.

vocabulary.note: Both meanings stay exactly as the source writes them. Nothing is translated; only the review flag is cleared.

answerKeys.note: Answers the source did not state, or stated only as a partial highlight. Each names the option's text rather than its letter, so the change cannot land on the wrong option if the order ever differs.

sourceCorrections.note: Two places where the source file itself is faulty and the teacher supplied the correction. Both are recorded here because they are the only points where stored content differs from the source document.

oddOneOut.why: The source reads 'correction – education – reaction- invite'. The dash before 'invite' has no space, so it was read as three options instead of four.

wordOrdering.why: The source word list contains 'broken' twice and an extraneous 'watch'. The teacher approved removing the duplicate and the extra word so the words form the answer the source itself prints.
wordOrdering.sentence: If your arm is broken, you will need to rest.
